G1.rationale: The principal result is the accuracy of a deep neural network trained on a public dataset; a third party can re-run the computation using the deposited data and described method.

The second subnetwork consists of two dense (fully connected) layers with 250 output nodes each. Outputs of both subnetworks are merged, and the merge layer is followed by two dense layers with 600 and 1 output nodes, respectively. All layers use the ReLU activation

specification.exact_target: Median percentage error (MdPE) for the ProteomeTools test set using the neural network with the full feature set after 26,000 training iterations: 1.28%.
specification.blind_target: The median percentage error of the deep convolutional neural network for predicting peptide collision cross sections on the ProteomeTools test set.

location_quotes.quote: The achieved median percentage error was 1.28%, and the root mean square error was 14.6 Å 2 .

method_quotes.quote: The first subnetwork consists of six convolutional layers. The last of them has 50 output channels (filters), and all other convolutional layers have an output of 150 channels. Between the third and fourth convolutional layers, a subsampling layer (kernel size and stride are 2) is connected. Kernel size and stride for all convolutional layers are 6 and 1,

The second subnetwork consists of two dense (fully connected) layers with 250 output nodes each. Outputs of both subnetworks are merged, and the merge layer is followed by two dense layers with 600 and 1 output nodes, respectively. All layers use the ReLU activation

specification.comparison_metric: The reported MdPE value (1.28%) is compared to the MdPE computed by the solver on the ProteomeTools test set using the same model architecture and training procedure.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Performance metrics on the identical split: the computed MdPE should match the reported value within the displayed rounding bin (i.e., 1.28% when rounded to two decimal places).
specification.specification_gaps: The exact random seed for data splitting and weight initialization is not specified; the precise composition of the ProteomeTools test set after removal of overlapping peptides is not detailed; the exact version of the external test set from reference [13] is not provided.
specification.alternatives_considered: The root mean square error (RMSE) of 14.6 Å² was considered but rejected because the paper emphasizes MdPE as the most relevant accuracy measure for scoring systems. The MdPE for the external test set (2.73%) was also considered but rejected because it is not the principal result; the ProteomeTools test set is the primary benchmark.
